Container.Name: pick-a-recipe
Container.Overview: Extract recipes from TikTok/YouTube/Instagram videos with AI and export them to Tandoor, Mealie, or a Mela .melarecipe file. Built from your own fork's GitHub Actions image (see UNRAID.md in the repo).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the Flask web UI listens on

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent data: SQLite database, cookies, Mela exports

Config.Name: FLASK_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Random secret for session cookies — generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS
Config.Description: How many video extraction jobs run in parallel (1-16)

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Set to false if not running behind a reverse proxy

Config.Name: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set to true only when served over HTTPS
